name: agent-pipeline
description: Portable multi-agent pipeline: run one task, or a whole roadmap as a pool of parallel workers, with a live browser control room.

scripts.typecheck: for f in pipeline/*.mjs pipeline/ui/*.mjs evals/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs skills/orchestrate/scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.demo:ui: node scripts/seed-demo-ui.mjs completed && npm run ui
